name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: Slides on Embla, as the reference: a frame of slides on travelling 1px seams with a control row of cells (previous, n / N with position ticks, next). APG carousel without rotation: named region, slides labelled n of N, out-of-view slides inert, arrow keys mirrored in RTL, moves announced politely, instant steps under reduced motion.
whenToUse: Use it for a few slides a reader moves through in turn, such as product photos. For content that must all be compared at once use Item or Table.

parts.name: Carousel
parts.description: The frame. Slides sit side by side on 1px seams inside it; the control row (CarouselBar) is its foot. Direction follows the page: in RTL the first slide is at the inline start and the arrows mirror.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element. Names the region ("Dock photos"). Required: a carousel is a landmark-like region.

parts.name: CarouselBar
parts.description: The control row: previous, position, next. Compose your own from the same parts if needed.

parts.name: CarouselContent
parts.description: The viewport, which clips the slides; the track inside it moves. `className`, `style` and `render` are the viewport's; `trackClassName` styles the track.

parts.name: CarouselItem
parts.description: One slide: a group named "n of N". `basis` is the share of the viewport it takes ("50%" shows two). Slides out of view are inert.

parts.name: CarouselPosition
parts.description: Where you are: "2 / 5" in the Code voice and a row of position ticks you can press. The current position is one ink band that STRETCHES between ticks: its leading edge reaches the new tick first and the trailing edge follows, so a step or a jump shows its direction and distance, the way the slides travel. Zero bounce; reduced motion places it at once. With many slides (12 or more) the ticks give way to the count alone.

parts.name: CarouselPrevious
parts.description: Previous / next: cells of the control row, rendered by Button. At an end they stay focusable and say why they do nothing.
